Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have set out the cost drivers carefully and previously explained the committee’s role in larger price changes—it sounds like a defensible adjustment that is straightforward to approve matters to you. We want to recognise genuine cost pressure while keeping our longstanding partnership commercially sustainable for both sides. How can we balance price and payment timing to make that work within your approval process?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your confirmation of the 6,110 units annual volume. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €374.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Extending payment terms to 90 days increases our capital costs, which would require a higher unit price rather than a reduction. To offer you the most favorable pricing, we propose maintaining the 30-day payment term with a revised price of €370.50 per unit at our standard terms, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Both your pricing explanation and Credit Control’s note emphasise payment timing—it sounds like financing costs are central to your pricing flexibility. We want a transparent agreement that recognises those costs and supports our long-term partnership. How can we separate the underlying motor cost from the financing component so we can assess the price on a shared factual basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have reviewed your updated demand forecast and incorporated the verified volume increase into our calculation. To accommodate your preference for a 90-day payment term, we must account for the associated financing costs, resulting in a revised unit price of EUR 372.69. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €372.69 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our relevant departments will address your inquiries regarding the price basis and cost breakdown separately. Please note that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You link the revised price directly to financing and reiterate that your calculation stays internal—it sounds like recovering those costs without opening your books is central for you. We respect that boundary and want a fair, sustainable agreement for our long-term partnership. What flexibility do you have on price within your approval authority while recognising the financing burden you have identified?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.21 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

To support our partnership while accommodating your requested payment terms, we can make a further concession to EUR 372.25. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

Consequently, our current Angebot comprises a price of €372.25 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your account team has accommodated extended payment while Credit Control still cites standard terms; it seems internal alignment on cash flow matters alongside price. We appreciate your concession and want a sustainable agreement that respects your confidential costing and our long-standing partnership. How can we resolve the remaining price adjustment within your approval authority and secure clear internal agreement on payment?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.70 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. Please be advised that our general terms dictate this position. For your information regarding any current Angebot, our offer remains valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
